2607.16085.title: Controlling Implicit Shortcut Reliance in L2 Spoken English Auto-markers
2607.16085.paper_summary: Increasingly, speech and language processing tasks take either audio or text directly rather than extracting features from these as the input to the classifier or regressor. Often these systems make use of complex, for example transformer-based, processes that have the ability to derive highly non-linear mappings between the input and the output. Unfortunately these systems can also learn ''shortcuts'' where the classifier is overly reliant on particular aspects of the input to yield the output. For the task of language proficiency assessment, this over-reliance can enable learners to increase their score by exploiting the shortcut rather than improving their ability. This paper introduces a novel training criterion that is able to reduce the classifier's reliance on shortcuts, thus for example limiting this option for malpractice in language assessment. This process is illustrated on two forms of assessment system, one based on the audio the other on the speech recognition text. The results show that, for both systems, there is higher correlations with features that could be exploited for malpractice than expected from the human reference, indicating an over-reliance on these features. By introducing the modified training criterion, this correlation can be reduced to be closer to the reference correlation.
2607.16085.paper_summary_zh: 逐漸地，語音和語言處理任務直接使用音頻或文本，而不是從這些數據中提取特徵作為分類器或回歸器的輸入。這些系統通常利用複雜的過程，例如基於Transformer的過程，具備推導輸入與輸出之間高度非線性映射的能力。不幸的是，這些系統也可能學習到“捷徑”，使得分類器過度依賴輸入的特定方面來產生輸出。對於語言能力評估的任務，這種過度依賴可能使學習者通過利用捷徑來提高他們的分數，而不是改善他們的能力。本文介紹了一種新穎的訓練標準，能夠減少分類器對捷徑的依賴，因此例如限制在語言評估中的不當行為選項。這一過程在兩種評估系統上進行了說明，一種基於音頻，另一種基於語音識別文本。結果顯示，對於這兩個系統，與可能被利用於不當行為的特徵之間的相關性高於人類參考所預期的，這表明對這些特徵的過度依賴。通過引入修改過的訓練標準，這種相關性可以減少，使其更接近參考相關性。
